description: Converts a note voltage into the control voltage that selects the mode on Bidoo's Dikt@t quantizer

inputs.text: The note that picks the mode, read over C4 to A7; unpatched the module reads C4

outputs.text: A voltage from 0.017V to 10V, rising 0.222V per semitone of input, which selects the Dikt@t mode

inputs.0:
unipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
